κούρην: κούρη — girl, daughter (epic = Attic κόρη); fem. acc. sg.
κούρης: κούρη — girl, maiden (Attic κόρη); fem. gen. sg.
κραδίην: κραδίη — heart (epic = Attic καρδία); fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ην
κρατερὸν: κρατερός — strong, mighty (by-form of καρτερός); masc./neut. acc. sg.
κρείων: κρείων — ruling, lord, sovereign; masc. nom. sg., epithet of kings (εὐρὺ κρείων ’wide-ruling’)
κῆλα: κῆλον — shaft, arrow (poetic, of a god’s missiles); neut. nom. pl.
λίσσετο: λίσσομαι — beg, entreat, pray to; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐλίσσετο)

λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the people’
λοιγὸν: λοιγός — ruin, destruction, havoc; masc. acc. sg.
λυσόμενός: λύω — loose, release; mid. ’ransom, get freed’; fut. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., of purpose: ’to ransom’ (accented before an enclitic)

μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.

μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; + dat./acc./gen. · also an adverb, ’among them’, or a preverb in tmesis

μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’

μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’)
νηυσὶ: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί)

νόῳ: νόος — mind, thought; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’in mind, in thought’
νῆας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)

οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’
οἶσθα: οἶδα — know; perf. 2 sg. with pres. force: ’you know’
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲν: οὐδείς, οὐδεμία, οὐδέν — no one, nothing; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’not at all’
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)

πένθος: πένθος — grief, sorrow; neut. nom. sg.

πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.; also adverbial, ’much, earnestly’
ποτε: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv. · with a negative or ἤν: ’never, if ever’
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’)
πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)

σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat.

τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’

τώ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, they two’ (τώ γε)

ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual adj./pron., of two persons: ’both (of them)’
ἄνακτι: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. dat. sg.
ἄποινα: ἄποινα — ransom (a neuter plural noun); nom./acc. pl.
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄριστον: ἀγαθός — good; superl. ἄριστος, masc. acc. sg.: ’best’
ἅλα: ἅλς — sea, salt sea; fem. acc. sg.
ἅμα: ἅμα — together, at the same time; adv. · also prep. + dat.: ’together with’

ἐλθὼν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’

ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’

ἔγνω: γιγνώσκω — come to know, learn, perceive; aor. 3 sg., no augment needed: ’recognised’

ἔκλυε: κλύω — hear, hearken to, heed; aor. 3 sg. (+ gen. of person heard)
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔριδος: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contention; fem. gen. sg.
ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
ἔτελλε: τέλλω — with ἐπί (ἐπιτέλλω), ’enjoin, lay a charge on’; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχει: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 sg. · also intransitive with an adverb, ’be in a state’: εὖ … κομιδὴ ἔχει ’the tending is in good order’

ἕλωμαι: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., with κεν: ’I shall take’
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει)
ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
ἥνδανε: ἁνδάνω — please, be pleasing to, + dat.; impf. 3 sg., augmented (η- from the root’s lost digamma)

ἧκε: ἵημι — send, let go, let fall; aor. 3 sg. (with πρό in tmesis: ’sent forth’)
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἱερὴν: ἱερός — sacred, holy; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ήν (= Attic ἱεράν)
ἱερῆα: ἱερεύς — priest; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic ἱερέα)
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj.
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg.
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)

ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic
ὔμμες: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; nom. pl., epic ὔμμες (= Attic ὑμεῖς)
ὠκὺς: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. sg.; πόδας ὠκύς ’swift in feet’
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’
ᾤχετο: οἴχομαι — be gone, go, have gone; impf. 3 sg., augmented (οἰ- → ᾠ-): ’had gone’ · also of continuous motion, ’went about, kept going’ (κατὰ πτόλιν ᾤχετο πάντῃ ’she went everywhere throughout the city’)
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
